summary: APES Times, MyAPES Portal and Stream 4 APES join APES CIC, Shelter & Rescue and Pet Care Clinic as channels, and staff choose which channels appear on the home page and in the menu from Newsletters settings.
detailed_changes: New channel pages at /apes-times, /myapes-portal and /stream-4-apes list their stories, with a Subscribe button for that newsletter and a short description when a channel has no stories yet (#526).
The home page shows a section for each visible channel with its three latest stories and a Subscribe link, in the order staff set. The layout fits six channels on desktop and mobile (#528).
The menu groups all channels under a keyboard-accessible Channels button on desktop and a Channels list on mobile, and highlights the channel you are reading (#529).
Every channel has its own RSS feed and sitemap entry, and channel pages include description, canonical and social preview tags that link previews can read (#530).
Posts can be filed under APES Times, MyAPES Portal and Stream 4 APES. The post editor's Channel field lists every channel whose newsletter is active (#527).

Each newsletter has Public channel settings: the linked channel, show on the home page, show in the menu, display order, and a public label and description. Archived newsletters never appear publicly, and the slug is locked while a channel is linked so signup links keep working (#525).

Imported Ghost posts are filed by the Ghost newsletter they were sent with. A new ghost:backfill-post-channels command lists and, with --force, refiles earlier imports that belonged to the three new newsletters, without sending email (#527).
affected_areas: User groups affected: all readers (home page, menu, channel pages); staff and admins (newsletter and post settings)
Public impact: three new channel pages, a Channels menu and channel sections on the home page
Internal impact: new channel settings columns on newsletters; ghost:backfill-post-channels command
